title: Create Gunpowder factory
description: amazing factory options easy and fun gun powder automation
body:
lately ive been playing alot of Create big cannons and Create radars and a problem i noticed is the whole gun powder shortage, and thats why i would like to present to u Create Gun Powder factory user friendly gun powder automation.

the recipes are easy but not free really fun to automate,

to get started all you gotta do is press gravel and press it again and ur ready to go,

ofc this mod has js started and more updates are coming soon
